pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, polygonal dark brown regions with moderate edge angularity visible on the flank; neck patches are largely obscured or replaced by hyper-keratotic textural disruption.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Cream-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous mesh on the mid-to-lower flank; junction nodes are clear with variable pixel thickness between 5 and 20 pixels.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The 1D silhouette is dominated by large-scale, low-frequency convexities representing massive tissue protrusions rather than a standard mane; high amplitude irregularities against the sky background.
dorsal_ridge_profile.contour_gaps: Extensive structural breaks in the dorsal line where typical mane anatomy is replaced by protruding, dark, bulbous masses.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Massive localized areas of extreme textural disruption and hyper-pigmentation; cauliflower-like growths extend from the upper neck across the dorsal ridge and into the primary flank patches.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe, widespread dermatological lesions characterized by raised, crusty, and dark-pigmented growths covering approximately 40% of the visible dorsal and lateral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, light-colored avian organism (likely an oxpecker) perched on the cranial-most dorsal lesion.
